articles.title: 3 young DeFi apps return $100M in revenue to token holders in 30 days
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid, EdgeX and Pump.fun returned a combined $96 million to token holders in 30 days, as the crypto community shifts its focus from transaction volumes to real earnings.

articles.title: Bitcoin price may dip toward $70K as Cleveland Fed estimates hotter inflation print
articles.snippet: BTC’s rising wedge points to a possible drop toward $70,000 as Strategy pauses buying and inflation cools Fed rate-cut hopes.
